citations.assessment: The printed Bavli begins with Rav Huna and then rejects that attribution in favor of Rav Hamnuna. This supports the formula here; the one-to-one identification need not be applied globally.
The parallel formula entry repeats the claim. The Hamnuna notices distinguish two people with that name, so the link identifies a textual parallel.
